observations: Three solar panels are shown mounted on a white metal frame.
The panels are 25mm thick, 618W, 135V, and 150W as indicated by the watermark.
The panels are installed outdoors on a concrete surface.
A person is partially visible on the left side of the image.
The image contains a watermark for 'NAGOTECH SOLAR' and 'POSTED ON Jiji'.
The photo appears to be a screenshot from a mobile device (CAMON 30).

claims.evidence: The watermark in photo 0 states 618W, 135V, and 150W.
The watermark in photo 0 states 135V, which is typical for 144-cell panels, but the cells themselves are not clearly visible.
No Canadian branding or labels are visible in the photo.

claims.claim: Battery is new, holds charge for 8 hours. Never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The panels may be used or have physical damage not visible in the photo.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the front and back of each panel showing all cells and the frame.

risks.risk: The panels may be non-functional or have low efficiency.
risks.proof: A video showing the panels connected to a multimeter or a load to demonstrate power output.

risks.risk: The actual wattage may be significantly lower than the 650W claimed.
risks.proof: A photo of the technical specification label on the back of the panels.

proof_requests: Close-up photos of the technical specification label on the back of each panel to confirm the model and wattage.
A video showing the panels producing power under direct sunlight.
Photos of the front and back of the panels to check for scratches or cracks.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
